title: Lease
description: Layer: interface · JSON Schema · TOPAK source: ADR-0031 §1 (twelve fields, closed), topak-core/src/lease.rs. This is what ADR-0057 §9 asks for when a record next touches the lease: a machine-readable schema node whose edges run to ADR-0031 §1 and from lease.rs. Closed: additionalProperties is false, and every field is required.

persona.description: Persona digest, attested at grant and renewal (ADR-0016 §6).

epoch.description: Valid at this epoch; any increment fences it (ADR-0022 §2).

fence.description: The Paxos log index at grant. The lease's identity (ADR-0031 §2).

rulesEpoch.description: Rules epoch in force at grant.

bundle.description: Bundle revision admitted against; fixed across renewal (R2).

rung.description: 0 none declared (Mediated, always) · 1 launcher · 2 measured boot · 3 confidential VM. Fixed across renewal (A1).

alphabet.description: Variants this seat may express. Renewal may only narrow it (§4).

round.description: Never reused per seat (ADR-0003). Fixed across renewal (R1).

role.description: Not ordered: a change is a grant (R1).

ttl_ms.description: Duration on the local monotonic clock; at most T_persona (A2).
